tools.name: show_letter
tools.description: Shows one letter as a capital and a small letter with numbered pen strokes and direction arrows, stroke playback, a trace pad that scores the tracing, and the matching printable sheet. Accepts cursive in five styles or print.

tools.name: show_alphabet
tools.description: Shows the full A to Z chart for cursive in one of five styles or for print, with every capital and small letter, and the printable alphabet sheet.

tools.name: compare_styles
tools.description: Shows one letter or a short word in all five cursive styles side by side, with stroke playback for each: Zaner-Bloser, Palmer Method, D'Nealian, Spencerian and Copperplate.

tools.name: practice_handwriting
tools.description: Opens the one-lane handwriting practice: the text in a horizontally scrollable lane with a guide, stroke playback, a trace pad and a score. Takes custom text or a practice preset id such as everyday words, loops and joins, numbers, a lesson exercise or a kids size set.

tools.name: make_worksheet
tools.description: Previews the printable practice sheet pages for a text or a practice preset in a chosen alphabet, style, paper size, guide and repeat count, with a PDF download from the site.

tools.name: generate_signature
tools.description: Writes a name in the signature styles of the CursiveLines generator: six style ideas with advice, plus the handwritten styles of famous signatures. Each style opens the generator with the name and style filled in, where the PNG and SVG download.

tools.name: browse_signatures
tools.description: Shows a scrollable gallery of famous signatures from the CursiveLines collection with the specimen images, searchable by name and filterable by category.

tools.name: find_handwriting
tools.description: Searches the CursiveLines handwriting lessons and guides by letter, topic or practice task and returns matching pages with thumbnails.
